'''The Void''' was a pocket of clear [[Realspace/Legends|space]] within the [[Pirate's Shadow]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The Void was heavily contested by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and the [[Hidden Daggers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group.
